title: Append a line
summary: Two redirection signs append text to the end of a file. Earlier content stays in place.
introduction: Two redirection signs append text to the end of a file. Earlier content stays in place. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Two redirection signs append text to the end of a file. Earlier content stays in place.
Zoo appears after the existing lines.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not confuse >> with >, which replaces the file contents.
For more detail later, use this [Linux further reading](https://www.gnu.org/software/coreutils/manual/coreutils.html).

seo.title: Linux: Append a line
seo.description: Learn about append a line in Linux. Follow a small example, understand the result, and practise with a clear question.
